Ferna Terms of Use

Effective date: October 27, 2026

These Terms govern your use of Ferna, provided by One Lever Labs LLC (“we,” “us,” or “our”). By using Ferna, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

1. About Ferna

Ferna provides plant-care tools, reminders, educational content, AI-assisted plant identification, and plant-health suggestions. Features may change over time.

Ferna is intended for users aged 13 or older. If you are below the age of legal adulthood where you live, you must have permission from a parent or guardian to use the app and make purchases.

2. Accounts and local data

Some features work without an account. Features involving AI or subscriptions may require sign-in.

You are responsible for protecting your account and for activity you authorize through it.

Garden data is currently stored locally on your device and is not automatically backed up or synchronized to a Ferna cloud database. Uninstalling the app, clearing its data, or losing your device may permanently remove that information.

3. AI and plant-care guidance

AI-generated identification, diagnoses, and care suggestions can be inaccurate or incomplete. They are provided for informational purposes and are not professional agricultural, medical, veterinary, or toxicological advice.

Do not rely on Ferna to determine whether a plant is edible, poisonous, safe for pets or children, or suitable for medicinal use. Obtain qualified advice where safety is involved.

Follow product labels, local laws, and professional guidance when using pesticides, fertilizers, or other treatments. We do not guarantee plant identification, recovery, or care outcomes.

4. Subscriptions and billing

Ferna offers optional Premium subscriptions with monthly or yearly billing. Available features, prices, billing periods, and any introductory offers are shown before purchase.

Payment is charged through your Apple App Store or Google Play account when you confirm your purchase, subject to the store’s payment rules.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before renewal under the applicable store’s rules. Apple generally requires cancellation at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. Your store account shows the applicable renewal date and cancellation options.

You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple or Google subscription settings. Cancellation generally stops future renewals; access ordinarily continues until the end of the paid period unless the store determines otherwise.

Deleting the app or your Ferna account does not cancel your subscription.

Refund requests are handled under the policies of the store where you purchased the subscription and any rights provided by applicable law. We do not limit any mandatory consumer rights.

If a free trial or introductory offer is available, its eligibility, duration, subsequent price, and renewal terms will be displayed before purchase. Unless canceled under the applicable store’s rules, the subscription will renew at the disclosed price after the offer ends.

Purchases may be restored where supported by the original store and your Ferna account. Access across devices or platforms depends on the applicable store, account, and product configuration.
